tools.name: api_list
tools.description: List APIs the authenticated caller may access in the current workspace.

tools.name: api_get
tools.description: Get one API by its stable API ID.

tools.name: api_create
tools.description: Create an API in the authenticated caller workspace.

tools.name: draft_get
tools.description: Retrieve the current canonical draft for an API by its stable API ID.

tools.name: draft_validate
tools.description: Validate the current canonical draft for an API by its stable API ID.

tools.name: endpoint_create
tools.description: Create a structured endpoint in an API draft.

tools.name: endpoint_update
tools.description: Update a structured endpoint in an API draft.

tools.name: endpoint_delete
tools.description: Delete a structured endpoint from an API draft.

tools.name: step_create
tools.description: Create a supported structured step in an API draft endpoint.

tools.name: step_update
tools.description: Update a supported structured step in an API draft endpoint.

tools.name: step_delete
tools.description: Delete a structured step from an API draft endpoint.

tools.name: step_reorder
tools.description: Set the order of all steps in an API draft endpoint using stable step IDs.

tools.name: secret_list
tools.description: List metadata for secrets in the authenticated caller workspace.

tools.name: secret_create
tools.description: Create a workspace secret. Submitted values are never returned.

tools.name: secret_rotate
tools.description: Rotate one workspace secret. Submitted values are never returned.

tools.name: secret_deactivate
tools.description: Deactivate one workspace secret without exposing its values.

tools.name: connection_list
tools.description: List safe metadata for upstream connections in the authorized workspace.

tools.name: connection_get
tools.description: Get safe metadata for one upstream connection in the authorized workspace.

tools.name: connection_create
tools.description: Create an upstream connection using safe configuration and auth-profile references.

tools.name: connection_update
tools.description: Update an upstream connection using safe configuration and auth-profile references.

tools.name: deployment_list
tools.description: List deployment environments and their states for an API.

tools.name: deployment_get_state
tools.description: Get full deployment state including environments and rollback targets for an API.

tools.name: deployment_deploy
tools.description: Deploy the current draft to the Dev environment.

tools.name: deployment_promote
tools.description: Promote a version from one environment to the next supported environment (Dev to Test, Test to Prod).

tools.name: deployment_rollback
tools.description: Rollback an environment to a previous version.

tools.name: deployment_undeploy
tools.description: Undeploy an environment, disabling it.

tools.name: deployment_history
tools.description: List deployment history for an API.
